answer: On signup, assign each key a random geocache site and short-lived nonce; a licensed host signs an NFC scan plus a return code only after the seeker reaches the cache and solves its clue. The registry consumes that site-day serial and rejects duplicate or out-of-window scans. Proposed host and verification fee is .20 per visit, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .20 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,200 (1,000 × .20). Bind scans to a mirror/jetty/anchor nonce. Limitation: travel barriers persist, and a host can collude.
